raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#43709: /v1/audio/transcriptions buffers the whole multipart upload with `await file.read()` before any validation runs — only response_format is checked first — so a single large upload lands entirely in host memory regardless of what the serving layer does with it next. Every other client-supplied media path already has a limit (the remote-media path enforces `media_url_max_file_size_mb` while streaming); the upload path had none.

## Modifications

Per-endpoint cap per the discussion on the issue: a new `--audio-transcription-max-file-size-mb` (default 25 MiB, matching the OpenAI API limit for this endpoint; 0 disables — same semantics as `media_url_max_file_size_mb`). Over-limit uploads get a 413: the declared-size precheck rejects honest clients before any buffering, and a chunked read enforces the cap when the declared size is missing or lies. I went per-endpoint rather than an app-wide body middleware since that changes every route at once — happy to switch if a middleware is preferred, and happy to close this in favor of another implementation if one is already in flight.

## Accuracy Tests

No model-output changes — the cap only gates what reaches the serving layer; under-limit uploads pass through byte-identical. New unit tests cover the precheck, streaming enforcement against a lying declared size, the pass-through, the 0-disables path, and the response_format-first ordering (`test_transcription_upload_limit.py`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not perf-sensitive: one int comparison on the request path; the chunked read iterates in 1 MiB steps.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to the [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (mdx row added next to `--media-url-max-file-size-mb`)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). +_UPLOAD_READ_CHUNK_BYTES = 1024 * 1024

+
+async def _read_upload_with_limit(file: UploadFile, max_bytes: int):
+    """Read an upload in bounded chunks, None once it exceeds ``max_bytes``.
+
+    Starlette spools an UploadFile to a temp file past a small in-memory
+    threshold, but ``await file.read()`` then buffers the whole thing in host
+    memory before any validation runs (sglang#43709) — a cheap way for a
+    client to exhaust the host. Reading in chunks enforces the cap while
+    streaming, mirroring how the remote-media limit is enforced.
+    """
+    chunks = []
+    total = 0
+    while True:
+        chunk = await file.read(_UPLOAD_READ_CHUNK_BYTES)
+        if not chunk:
+            break
+        total += len(chunk)
+        if total > max_bytes:
+            return None
+        chunks.append(chunk)
+    return b"".join(chunks)
+
+
+def _transcription_upload_too_large(max_bytes: int) -> ORJSONResponse:
+    return ORJSONResponse(
+        content={
+            "error": {
+                "message": (
+                    "Transcription upload exceeds the configured "
+                    f"{max_bytes // (1024 * 1024)} MiB limit "
+                    "(--audio-transcription-max-file-size-mb)"
+                )
+            }
+        },
+        status_code=413,
+    )
+

@@ -0,0 +1,161 @@
+"""Unit tests for the transcription upload size cap (sglang#43709).
+
+The /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint used to buffer the whole multipart
+upload in host memory via ``await file.read()`` before any validation ran.
+These tests pin the new contract: over-limit uploads are rejected with a 413
+— via the declared-size precheck when the client is honest, and via the
+chunked read when the declared size is missing or lies — and the serving
+layer is never reached for rejected uploads.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()  # must precede any import that pulls in sgl_kernel
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, Mock, patch
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server import (
+    _read_upload_with_limit,
+    openai_v1_audio_transcriptions,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_MIB = 1024 * 1024
+
+
+class _FakeUploadFile:
+    """starlette UploadFile semantics: read(size) returns up to size bytes."""
+
+    def __init__(self, data: bytes, declared_size=None):
+        self._data = data
+        self.size = declared_size
+        self._pos = 0
+
+    async def read(self, size: int = -1):
+        if size is None or size < 0:
+            size = len(self._data) - self._pos
+        chunk = self._data[self._pos : self._pos + size]
+        self._pos += len(chunk)
+        return chunk
+
+
+def _fake_mm(limit_mib: int):
+    return SimpleNamespace(audio_transcription_max_file_size_mb=limit_mib)
+
+
+def _raw_request(serving_result=None):
+    serving = Mock()
+    serving.create_transcription = AsyncMock(return_value=serving_result)
+    return (
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            app=SimpleNamespace(
+                state=SimpleNamespace(openai_serving_transcription=serving)
+            )
+        ),
+        serving.create_transcription,
+    )
+
+
+class ReadUploadWithLimitTest(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_under_limit_upload_is_returned_intact(self):
+        import asyncio
+
+        data = b"ab" * 1024  # 2 KiB
+        out = asyncio.run(_read_upload_with_limit(_FakeUploadFile(data), 4 * _MIB))
+        self.assertEqual(out, data)
+
+    def test_over_limit_stream_returns_none(self):
+        import asyncio
+
+        # 3 MiB of data against a 2 MiB cap; the declared size is absent so
+        # only the chunked read can catch it.
+        data = b"x" * (3 * _MIB)
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            asyncio.run(_read_upload_with_limit(_FakeUploadFile(data), 2 * _MIB))
+        )
+
+    def test_exact_limit_passes(self):
+        import asyncio
+
+        data = b"x" * (2 * _MIB)
+        out = asyncio.run(_read_upload_with_limit(_FakeUploadFile(data), 2 * _MIB))
+        self.assertEqual(len(out), 2 * _MIB)
+
+    def test_empty_upload_returns_empty_bytes(self):
+        import asyncio
+
+        self.assertEqual(
+            asyncio.run(_read_upload_with_limit(_FakeUploadFile(b""), _MIB)), b""
+        )
+
+
+class TranscriptionUploadLimitTest(CustomTestCase):
+    def _run(self, file, limit_mib, serving_result=None):
+        import asyncio
+
+        raw_request, serving = _raw_request(serving_result)
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server.get_mm",
+            return_value=_fake_mm(limit_mib),
+        ):
+            response = asyncio.run(
+                openai_v1_audio_transcriptions(
+                    raw_request=raw_request, file=file, response_format="json"
+                )
+            )
+        return response, serving
+
+    def test_declared_over_limit_rejects_before_reading(self):
+        file = _FakeUploadFile(b"anything", declared_size=30 * _MIB)
+        response, serving = self._run(file, limit_mib=25)
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 413)
+        self.assertIn(
+            "--audio-transcription-max-file-size-mb",
+            response.body.decode(),
+        )
+        serving.assert_not_awaited()
+
+    def test_lying_declared_size_is_caught_while_streaming(self):
+        # Declared 1 MiB, actually 30 MiB: only the chunked read catches it.
+        file = _FakeUploadFile(b"x" * (30 * _MIB), declared_size=_MIB)
+        response, serving = self._run(file, limit_mib=25)
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 413)
+        serving.assert_not_awaited()
+
+    def test_under_limit_upload_reaches_the_serving_layer(self):
+        data = b"real audio bytes"
+        file = _FakeUploadFile(data, declared_size=len(data))
+        response, serving = self._run(file, limit_mib=25, serving_result="ok")
+        self.assertEqual(response, "ok")
+        serving.assert_awaited_once()
+        self.assertEqual(serving.await_args.kwargs["audio_data"], data)
+
+    def test_zero_limit_disables_the_cap(self):
+        data = b"x" * (40 * _MIB)
+        file = _FakeUploadFile(data, declared_size=len(data))
+        response, serving = self._run(file, limit_mib=0, serving_result="ok")
+        self.assertEqual(response, "ok")
+        self.assertEqual(serving.await_args.kwargs["audio_data"], data)
+
+    def test_invalid_response_format_still_rejected_first(self):
+        import asyncio
+
+        raw_request, serving = _raw_request()
+        response = asyncio.run(
+            openai_v1_audio_transcriptions(
+                raw_request=raw_request,
+                file=_FakeUploadFile(b"x"),
+                response_format="srt",
+            )
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 400)
+        serving.assert_not_awaited()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
